name: ShopNest – E-Commerce Platform
desc: A full-featured e-commerce platform with real-time inventory, secure payments via Stripe, role-based authentication, admin dashboard with analytics, and mobile-first responsive design.
challenges: Implementing real-time cart sync across tabs, handling race conditions in inventory updates during flash sales, and integrating Stripe webhooks securely in a serverless environment.
future: Add AI-powered product recommendations, wishlist sharing, multi-vendor support, and a PWA for offline browsing.

name: TaskFlow – Management App
desc: A Kanban-style task management app with drag-and-drop columns, real-time collaboration via Firebase, team workspaces, progress analytics, and deadline notifications.
challenges: Smooth drag-and-drop on touch devices, real-time conflict resolution when two users edit the same card, and optimising Firestore reads for large boards.
future: Calendar timeline view, Gantt charts, Slack/Discord integrations, AI task auto-assignment based on team workload.

name: LearnHub – Learning Platform
desc: An e-learning platform where instructors upload video courses, students track progress, earn certificates, and participate in discussion forums.
challenges: Adaptive video streaming for low-bandwidth connections, building a rich text quiz editor, and a tamper-proof certificate QR system.
future: Live class sessions with WebRTC, peer-to-peer code review, AI quiz generation from course material, subscription monetisation.

name: CryptoPulse – Crypto Tracker
desc: Real-time cryptocurrency tracking dashboard that visualizes price trends, market cap, and trading volume for over 5000+ coins.
challenges: Handling high-frequency API polling without exceeding rate limits and ensuring smooth chart animations during rapid data updates.
future: Portfolio tracking with wallet integration (MetaMask), price alert push notifications, and news sentiment analysis.

name: HealthVue – Patient Portal
desc: A healthcare management system for booking appointments, viewing digital prescriptions, and tracking medical history securely.
challenges: Ensuring HIPAA-compliant data handling and creating a complex calendar logic for doctor availability slots.
future: Video consultation integration via Jitsi, AI symptom checker, and wearable device data sync.

name: SocialWave – Media Platform
desc: A modern social media experience with image sharing, liking/commenting, real-time notifications, and an explore feed.
challenges: Implementing an efficient 'infinite scroll' and optimizing image uploads for faster feed loading.
future: Direct messaging with Socket.io, story features (24h expiry), and short-form video support.

name: DevPort – Portfolio Builder
desc: A CMS-powered portfolio builder for developers to showcase their work with 3D elements and customizable themes.
challenges: Balancing 3D performance on mobile devices and creating a flexible schema for various project types.
future: One-click export to PDF resume, more 3D interactive scenes, and custom domain mapping.

name: ZenWeather – Weather Insights
desc: A minimal weather app that changes its background and UI based on the local weather condition with high accuracy.
challenges: Mapping dynamic weather icons to various API response codes and handling geolocation permissions gracefully.
future: 7-day hourly forecast charts, air quality index data, and severe weather alerts.

name: FoodieExpress – Delivery App
desc: A cross-platform food delivery application featuring live order tracking, restaurant ratings, and coupon management.
challenges: Synchronizing the driver's GPS location with the user's map in real-time using WebSockets.
future: Subscription-based 'Pro' delivery, multi-restaurant ordering, and voice search integration.

name: EcoTrack – Carbon Tracker
desc: An environmental impact calculator that helps users track their daily carbon footprint and suggests eco-friendly alternatives.
challenges: Building a reliable calculation engine based on complex environmental data points.
future: Community leaderboard, integration with smart home devices, and monthly sustainability reports.

name: VaultSafe – Password Manager
desc: A desktop-first secure vault for storing passwords and sensitive documents with end-to-end encryption.
challenges: Implementing master-password hashing using Argon2 and ensuring local-first data persistence.
future: Browser extension support, auto-fill capabilities, and biometric login (FaceID/Fingerprint).

name: AuraMusic – Streaming App
desc: A music streaming platform that allows users to discover trending tracks, create playlists, and see lyrics in real-time.
challenges: Managing global audio state across different pages and ensuring gapless playback.
future: Offline download mode, social listening rooms, and personalized 'Daily Mix' using ML.
